headline: Revenue and profit both grow at a healthy double-digit clip
summary_short: Ningbo Haitian Precision's H1 2026 revenue was ¥2.01B, up 20.5% y/y, with net profit attributable to shareholders up a similar 19.4% y/y to ¥283M; Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.33 rose 54.7% q/q.
summary_long: H1 2026 revenue reached ¥2.01B, up 20.5% y/y from ¥1.66B. Net profit attributable to shareholders was ¥283M, up 19.4% y/y from ¥237M — profit growth roughly tracked revenue growth, implying broadly stable margins. Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.33 rose 54.7% q/q from ¥0.2133. The fetched profit-statement table carries no MD&A narrative, so no specific cause is stated here for the top- and bottom-line growth; unverified third-party commentary (not from the filing itself) attributes some of the strength to overseas sales growth, but that isn't included as a driver.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback. First WebSearch initially surfaced prior-year (H1 2025) figures; WebFetch of Sina Finance's structured profit-statement table (non-aggregator) yielded the actual H1 2026 figures, cross-checked for consistency against the H1 2025 comparison column (matches the earlier WebSearch's own H1 2025 figures exactly: ¥1.663B revenue, ¥237M profit). A second WebSearch surfaced a Sina 'AI assist' stock-move analysis article claiming >50% y/y overseas revenue growth and margin benefits, but this reads as third-party/analyst framing rather than a verbatim company disclosure, so it is NOT included as a driver per the company-disclosed/derived-arithmetic rule — noted here only as unverified color. EPS row is the Q2-standalone actual from resolve-earnings-target.mjs's shard KPIs (Yahoo earningsChart) and is not on the same cumulative basis as the H1 revenue/profit rows.
